11wbxt: Original SpanishCue material; the situations and data are for teaching purposes, not real news or official exam texts.
1pift3r: The academy moved a workshop to a different room and forgot to notify two participants. When they arrived at the previous building, they found the door closed. One of them had asked to leave work early; the other had traveled from a nearby town. The apology message arrived the next day: «Se nos pasó avisarles. Estas cosas ocurren cuando hay mucho movimiento». The sentence acknowledged the oversight, but the comment that followed seemed to reduce the affected women's experience to an unavoidable inconvenience.
1bi5v21: The coordinator reviewed the case after receiving a complaint. The emails on the general list had been updated, but two registrations made in person did not appear on it. The problem was not only that someone had forgotten to press a button. There were two records that were not checked against each other. Presenting it as an individual accident would have allowed the conversation to be closed quickly, although it would have left intact the possibility of its happening again to other people.
y48uvi: In a second message, the academy explained the failure and accepted its consequences. It offered to make up the session at no cost and to refund the proportional amount to those who could not attend. It also committed to confirming future venue changes in two ways and to unifying the records. One participant accepted the make-up class; the other asked for the refund because the new schedule did not suit her either. The coordinator did not interpret that choice as a lack of understanding: a remedy does not oblige anyone to continue a relationship.
1non0uf: The team agreed to check after a month whether the procedure was being followed. The apology stopped being a sentence meant to obtain immediate forgiveness and became a sequence of actions. Saying se nos olvidó can naturally describe an unintentional error. Its effect depends on what comes next: an excuse that dilutes the harm or a commitment that lets the other person decide which solution they consider acceptable.
